title: Clannad: Mou Hitotsu no Sekai, Tomoyo-hen

alternative_titles.ja: -クラナド-　もうひとつの世界　智代編

synopsis:
Clannad: Mou Hitotsu no Sekai, Tomoyo-hen is set in an alternate reality where Tomoya Okazaki dates his junior, Tomoyo Sakagami.

Tomoyo has been elected to be the school's next Student Council President. This is great news as she can now work toward her goal of preventing the school's cherry blossom trees from being axed. Although Tomoya is ecstatic for her, given his reputation as a delinquent in school, his relationship with Tomoyo is making them the subject of gossip around the campus, which can potentially compromise her standing as Student Council President. The school community's disapproval of their relationship becomes more apparent when the Student Council's Vice-President and even the school's administration warn Tomoya to distance himself from Tomoyo.

With the bad atmosphere widening the rift between Tomoya and Tomoyo, will Tomoya succumb to societal pressure and do as they say, or will their love for each other rise above it all?

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

episodes_data.title: On a Slope with Falling Cherry Blossoms
episodes_data.description: Tomoya makes a new friend on the way to school named Nagisa. They become fast friends, so he decides to go to her parents` store to meet them.

episodes_data.title: The First Step
episodes_data.description: On the way to school, Tomoya is almost hit by a girl on a scooter. It won`t be his last strange encounter with a girl for the day.

episodes_data.title: Once More After the Tears
episodes_data.description: Tomoya is on his way to Nagisa`s house for a visit but ends up going to Youhei`s house instead. The next day he helps Nagisa out with her theater club.

episodes_data.title: Looking For Friends
episodes_data.description: The Student Council decides that Nagisa can`t reestablish the theater club. As the boys help her recruit, they meet the ghost of a girl who was killed in a car accident.

episodes_data.title: Scene with Sculptures
episodes_data.description: Tomoya and Nagisa want to help Fuuko. They take her to stay at Nagisa`s house and make arrangements to make one of her dreams come true.

episodes_data.title: The Sister's Founder's Festival
episodes_data.description: Fuuko tries to find people to attend her sisters wedding. Nagisa invites Fuuko`s sister to the Founders Festival.

episodes_data.title: Star-Shaped Feelings
episodes_data.description: Tomoya receives some shocking news about Fuuko, who may not ever awaken from her coma. They fight to keep her memory alive at school.

episodes_data.title: The Breeze Fading at Dusk
episodes_data.description: Fuuko is starting to fade from everyone`s memory. This complicates things, as Kouko`s wedding is coming up, and no one remembers the meaning of the starfish.

episodes_data.title: Until the End of the Dream
episodes_data.description: Tomoya, Nagisa and Fuuko spend the night at school. When they wake up the next morning, they cannot remember why they spent the night there.

episodes_data.title: The Girl Genius' Challenge
episodes_data.description: Tomoya introduces Kotomi to Nagisa in hopes it will convince her to join the theater club. As Tomoya watches Kotomi and Nagisa speaking, he decides Kotomi needs more friends.

episodes_data.title: Afterschool Rhapsody
episodes_data.description: Tomoya falls asleep at school only to awake to the sound of Kotomi playing the violin. A girl from the music room lent Kotomi the violin and wants everyone to hear her.

episodes_data.title: Hidden World
episodes_data.description: Kyou tries to purchase a stuffed elephant for Kotomi`s upcoming birthday. Just as Kyou is about to give up, Fuuko appears and convinces her to give Kotomi a star instead.

episodes_data.title: A Garden of Memories
episodes_data.description: Seeing Kotomi standing on newspaper clippings sparks Tomoya`s childhood memories. Kotomi and Tomoya recall their childhood friendship, and Kotomi explores her feelings.

episodes_data.title: Theory of Everything
episodes_data.description: Tomoya falls asleep in the garden after working through the night. A mysterious stranger waits for Kotomi at school with the intention to steal her parents` thesis.

episodes_data.title: A Problematic Matter
episodes_data.description: After she speaks with Toshio Koumura about becoming an adviser for their club, Nagisa recevies a letter to stop the theater club.

episodes_data.title: 3 on 3
episodes_data.description: When Nagisa, Tomoya, and Mei visit Sunohara, they find her dorm in shambles and no sign of Sunohara!

episodes_data.title: An Empty Space
episodes_data.description: After a basketball game, the choir club approaches Nagisa about the prospect of sharing Moumura as a mutual adviser between both clubs.

episodes_data.title: The Secret Plan of Reversal
episodes_data.description: Tomoya has been suspended from school, so he hangs out in his room all day thinking about Nagisa. In an attempt to make him feel better, Kyou and Ryou take him to the arcade.

episodes_data.title: A New Life
episodes_data.description: The theater club is finally established once Tomoyo is named student council president. When a meeting between his father and teacher approaches, Tomoya wants to run away.

episodes_data.title: A Secret Past
episodes_data.description: Nagisa wants to put on a play about a girl and a robot. While looking through a storage shed for reference books about the play, Nagisa and Tomoya are confronted by Akio.

episodes_data.title: Preparing for the School Festival
episodes_data.description: Akio has a video to show Nagisa and Tomoya. The next day`s rehearsal includes an energetic Nagisa who wants to put on a successful show.

episodes_data.title: Two Shadows
episodes_data.description: The day of the festival has arrived, and  Nagisa is so upset about what happened to her dad that she breaks down before she can perform in her play.

specials_data.title: It Happened During Summer Vacation
specials_data.description: Tomoya`s and Nagisa`s relationship has become stagnant. Mei tries to help them by convincing Nagisa to open up her heart more to Tomoya.

specials_data.title: Another World: Tomoyo Arc
specials_data.description: Former delinquent girl Tomoyo had applied for school president to save the sakura trees near the school; Tomoya supported her, and they have just begun dating. Tomoya is still a delinquent but Tomoyo helps him with learning, making bentos and waking him up every morning. When the election results are announced Tomoyo finds that she will now be able to pursue her dream. But teachers as well as schoolmates consider Tomoya a bad influence for this school`s aspiring new idol. Will their love be able to overcome all trials and tribulations?
